'''Surveillance Log 128/SR81''' was a [[Corellian Security Force]] report submitted by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Llek Hawser]]. Hawser was assigned to conduct surveillance on [[space platform]] [[3DC/Green]], suspected of harboring [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] sympathies. Hawser's report was sent to [[Kirtan Loor]], copied into to Hawser's supervisor, [[Gil Bastra]].<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>
